title: Mixed Event — First Star After the Rain — Episode4 Until Our Date

meta.Event Outline: Saki has formed a band with her childhood friends and is enjoying what each day brings. She happens upon a poster for an observatory event one day and decides to plan a visit with her bandmates, but...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I just wanted to ask... Whoa, why are your clothes all over the place? Are you starting a fashion show or something?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, I'm just picking out what to wear for a date.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Of course...!
You're not a little girl anymore....!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Whatever you do, you'll have my full support. Follow your heart!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What? Tsukasa, hold on!
Why are you giving me a “dad speech”?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm just going out with Ichi and the others!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
With Ichika and...?
Oh, your bandmates...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Was there something you wanted to ask me?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, it's about your plans for the next weekend. Everyone else is going to be away on a trip.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm doing a show then, so I won't be home either. I was worried about leaving you all alone in case something happened.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Well, you don't have to worry because I'm going out with my bandmates on Saturday!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
And anyway, you worry too much!
The doctor said I was fine.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I AM FINE!
You can go out and enjoy your weekend without being so concerned about me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay, I got it. Just... Remember to look both ways before you cross the road!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... It'd be terrible if I came down with something before then...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: As much as I enjoy my club and my job, I should take it easy. I'll go to bed early tonight.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you! See you next time!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hi, Saki. Is the soft tennis club done for the day?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah. The home ec club too?
Let's walk home together!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So in the end, I decided I'll wear the shorts I bought the other day and pair them with...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki, your face looks really flushed.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I don't feel like I'm running a fever.
Maybe I applied too much blush?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I don't think that's it... Just to be safe, maybe you should check your temperature when you get back home.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I'm sure it's nothing! My normal temperature's naturally a little higher than average.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (What if I do have a fever? Now that I think about it, I have been feeling a little out of it.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (No matter. A good night's sleep will make it go away.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I had a fever, like Hona said. I better head home early and make sure I get plenty of rest.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hm? It's from my boss...?
“Can anyone cover these shifts?”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I thought next month's schedule wouldn't be up for a while. Why are they already looking to cover shifts?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: “Our part-time staff leader, Ms. Yamada, said her child caught the flu and urgently needs to take a week off from work.” Whaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: “Please let me know ASAP if you can take any of her shifts.”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It looks like they're struggling with finding someone to cover Saturday, but that's the day we're going to the observatory...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Well, I'm busy on that day...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: “I'm sorry about the sudden call. Have you seen my message? Ms. Yamada's not coming in this week. Could you cover her shift on Saturday?”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm sorry, but I can't do Saturday...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: “What about today? I've got someone who can take the Saturday shift if you can swap with them today.”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I'll probably be okay if I make sure to pace myself. They really need my help.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes, I think I can make it today!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hey, Saki. You don't have club activities today, so you're going straight home, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sorry, Ichi! I have to cover someone's shift at the cafe. I've got to run or I won't make it. Bye!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'll have to remind her again to take it easy...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Sigh... I really have no luck today.
Why did it have to be so busy at work?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And I think my fever's gotten a little worse...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Maybe I should cancel band practice tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There's just one condition. Don't start slacking off with band practice because of this trip.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If I see you start to get lazy, I'm out. Got it?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If I don't go, our trip to the observatory might get canceled, too...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I have to buckle down and somehow hang on until Saturday.
